title: Sieve script compiled from SQLite on every inbound message
description: smtp/src/session.rs:541-561: sieve_for_user() loads the script from SQLite and compiles it on every message delivery. RFC 5228 syntax trees are non-trivial to parse. At 100 msg/sec to the same user, this is 100 compiles/sec. Fix: cache compiled scripts in an Arc<CompiledScript> keyed by (username, script_name), invalidated on sieve_admin PUT. The cache avoids redundant compilation while ensuring script updates take effect immediately.
